entities.summary: September Movement, a transformative movement in Indonesia (1959–1966). Emerged from Suharto assumes power through the Supersemar order and Asian-African Conference at Bandung launches the Non-Aligned Movement. Catalyzed 30 September Movement — attempted coup triggers mass anti-communist killings and Indonesia invades East Timor following Portuguese withdrawal.
